Very Low–Calorie Diets
Diets providing 200 to 800 kcal are classified as very low–
calorie diets (VLCDs). Little evidence suggests that an intake 
of fewer than 800 calories daily is of any advantage. An example 
of a significant exception to this would be the hospitalized 
patient on a metabolic unit who is monitored carefully, is less
